title: Stonewatch Tower

[[Image:Stonewatch Tower.jpg|thumb|300px|Stonewatch Tower]]
'''Stonewatch Tower''' is the secondary structure of the human stronghold of [[Stonewatch]], which also includes the [[Stonewatch Keep]]. They both used to be controlled by the [[human]]s of [[Lakeshire]] but were taken by [[orc]]s of the [[Blackrock clan]]. Now the tower is firmly in the hands of [[Gath'Ilzogg]]'s underlings.
